notes: sites_kept/site_years_kept are gated on the >=5-passing-year threshold (rule 4) -- a site with 1-4 passing years under a variant is not counted as 'kept'. *_vs_manuscript columns compare against the 'i_manuscript' row (share_pass_025==1 every year). site_years_added_by_newly_recovered_sites counts only the passing years of sites not kept under the manuscript rule at all; site_years_added_total_vs_manuscript also includes extra qualifying years gained at sites already kept under the manuscript rule.
